channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Congressional primary season ends with record departures and defeats
item.description: According to an NPR analysis, nearly 100 lawmakers from this Congress will not return for the next, driven by record-setting departures and defeats.

item.title: Congress faces pressure to regulate AI, but path forward uncertain
item.description: Lawmakers show broader willingness to regulate AI development, but the process may not move quickly.

item.title: Human brain cells in mice aid disease research, ethicists weigh next steps
item.description: Neuroscientists have advanced modeling of the human brain in mice, providing a new way to study conditions such as cerebral palsy. Ethicists are now considering the implications.

item.title: DOJ accuses Russian agents of plotting attacks, including in US
item.description: The indictment states the defendants are part of a network that is a branch of Russia's apparatus for conducting external attacks worldwide.
